title: payments-service — Deploy & Rollback Runbook
body: Deploying payments-service: 1) merge to main triggers the CI pipeline (lint, unit tests, integration tests against a staging ledger). 2) A canary rollout ships to 5% of pods for 15 minutes, watched against the canary-alarm dashboard (error rate, p99 latency, authorization failure rate). 3) If canary alarms stay green, promote to 100%; otherwise auto-rollback fires. Manual rollback: run `deploy rollback payments-service --to <previous-version>` from the deploy CLI, which reverts pods and drains in-flight requests gracefully. Marcus Webb is on call this week for any deploy that pages after hours; page via the Engineering on-call rotation for anyone else. See the PAY-2114 incident review for a real example of a canary-triggered rollback.
